channel.title: Projects on Mateus Interciso
channel.description: Recent content in Projects on Mateus Interciso

item.title: Asterisk infrastructure rebuild
item.description: Rebuilt the whole company’s telephony with 6 hours of downtime, starting from close to zero telephony knowledge.

item.title: Cellular automata and ternary representation
item.description: Master’s degree and a paper at IEEE CEC 2011 in New Orleans: ternary representation improves the search for density classifier cellular automata.

item.title: GenAI agent hub
item.description: From concept through business case, funding approval and delivery, with a dedicated 7-person squad. On time and on budget.

item.title: GenAI assistant for call centre operations
item.description: An assistant that supports level 1 analysts in resolving tickets and reduces escalation to level 2.

item.title: Genetic algorithms in C and CUDA
item.description: A series of reference genetic algorithm implementations in C and CUDA, from ‘hello world’ to the Robby problem.

item.title: Multiplayer game with Bluetooth joysticks
item.description: A totem running a 3D game where passing mobile phones became joysticks over Bluetooth. 2009, no SDK, no budget.

item.title: Oracle EBS to AWS migration automation
item.description: An Ansible-based solution that cut EBS clone migration and provisioning from 48 hours to 4 hours per instance.

item.title: pyAutomationAnywhere
item.description: A Python module for the Automation Anywhere API (v10.5), written because you can’t always use the Control Room to deploy a task.

item.title: RCA programme for a major Brazilian logistics company
item.description: RPA, a Python orchestration daemon, ML models and a web interface. Client-estimated annual gain of R$ 500 million.

item.title: RPA-as-a-service platform
item.description: Architecture and business case for an internal RPA-as-a-service offering, delivered and operated in production.

item.title: Virtual assistant platform
item.description: Took over a programme mid-flight, rebuilt both codebase and team, and shipped the stabilised version in 3 months. It now serves 5,000+ users.
